messages:
Maya R: FYI spotted something weird on na-prod quickpane: /v1/stream p50 = 310ms but p95 = 190ms. screenshot: https://img.redwood/snap/yyy
Jorge: wow, inversion again. quickpane or full breakdown view?
Maya R: quickpane summary tile under Endpoint -> /v1/stream. thought it was a chart rendering bug at first.
Liam: did anything touch rollup provenance or routing tags in the last 48h? we merged a fallback tag change last week.
release-bot: release 6135799001 completed by @ci-bot -- feature: routing-provenance=include_fallback=true
Anya: p50>p95 usually indicates mixed-origin merge with tdigest problems or weight misapplied during rollup.
Jorge: concrete: when kvcache-origin supplies a lot of tiny fast hits and client-origin has fewer slower samples, merge logic can underweight the slow tails causing percentile inversion.
Maya R: ok pragmatic asks: a) show sample_count on the quickpane tile b) surface provenance badge when >1 origin present c) show a faint orange "low sample" indicator for small counts
Liam: agree. backend change: add sample_count and origins array to rollup API, and fix tdigest merge normalization to guard against tiny-origin bias.
Jorge: also propose adding a rollup query flag provenance=full|compact so console can request explicit origins when the user toggles it. default remains compact for perf.
Anya: UX: small inline toggle next to percentiles: 'Show provenance' toggles the flag. tooltip: 'Percentiles reflect merged rollups; enable provenance to see origin breakdown.' keep it subtle.
Maya R: can we make the low-sample threshold configurable via feature flag? support wants to tune it per-tenant.
Liam: yes, add quickpane feature flag quickpane.low_sample_threshold with default 100.
Jorge: I'll patch the merge algorithm and add sample_count to response. plan: 36 hours. will also run a backfill recompute for the suspicious windows.
Liam: opened PR #1273: add sample_count + origins to rollup response; add provenance query param; tdigest weight fix + tests. tagging @eng-platform for review.
Anya: will wire the inline toggle in console; default off. PM okay with non-blocking change.
release-bot: deploy 6135801200 to staging scheduled by @release-scheduler
Liam: staging deploy done; smoke shows p95 now > p50 for the example window. low-sample badge visible on micro-slices.
Maya R: confirmed staging. can we include sample_count in the hovercard for the percentile value too? small UX win.
Anya: yep adding sample_count to hovercard.
Liam: scheduling prod roll for tonight 23:30 UTC: 6135831000. will post when live.
release-bot: scheduled 6135831000 for prod deploy by @release-scheduler
Maya R: leaving a short runbook blurb for support explaining the low-sample badge meaning and how to toggle provenance.
Jorge: also adding a short note in telemetry runbook about recompute and how to validate a fix.
Maya R: thanks all. glad it's telemetry/rollup surface rather than serving latencies.
